subject: general
question: Who among the following clocked 2:40:16 to pocket the men’s 35 km race walk national record at the Indian Open Race Walking Competition 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Juned Khan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When they took first place in the ninth **Indian Open Race-Walking Competition**, Juned Khan of **Haryana and Ramandeep Kaur of Punjab** respectively rewrote the men's and women's 35km** race walking National Records.**
 
• **Juned Khan, who did so in 2:40:16.00, set the previous national record.**
 
• After 20 kilometres in the men's race, Juned Khan, 22, separated himself from **Ram Baboo and Chandan Singh,** lowering the national record by five minutes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ram Baboo**

 
 
• ​On the final day of sports activities at the **National Games **in this city on Tuesday, **Uttar Pradesh athlete Ram Baboo** set a new national record for the 35km race walk with a time of 2 hours, 36 minutes, and 34 seconds.
 
• The 23-year-old Ram Baboo easily defeated Haryana's Juned Khan, who finished in 2:40:51.00 here and held the national record of 2:40:16.00 set in the **National Race Walking championships in Ranchi** this year, in a race that was established last year and made its National Games debut this week.
 
 
 
• **Chandan Singh**
 
 
• ​Chandan Singh, an **Indian racewalker** who competes in the 20-kilometer and 20-kilometer walk races, was born on June 8, 1987.
 
 
 
• **Akshdeep Singh**
 
 
• **​Akshdeep Singh, a trainee at SAI Bengaluru**, took home the gold medal in the men's 20-kilometre racewalk in the **Khelo India University Games in 2021.**
 
• Before heavy rain stopped the athletic competition at the 2nd Khelo India University Games at the **Sree Kanteerava Stadium, **Akshdeep Singh of Punjabi University won the gold medal in the men's 20km race walk and **Aparna Roy** of Kerala won the women's 100m hurdles.
